paras: Bronchocela orlovi, also known commonly as Orlov's forest lizard, is a species of lizard in the subfamily Draconinae of the family Agamidae. The species is endemic to Vietnam
The specific name, orlovi, is in honor of Russian herpetologist Nikolai Liutsianovich Orlov.
Bronchocela orlovi is found in Gia Lai province in the Central Highlands of Vietnam.
The natural habitat of Bronchocela orlovi is forest, at elevations of approximately 750 m (2,460 ft).
Bronchocela orlovi is arboreal and diurnal.
